notes.title: Catizens is out in full release!
notes.content:
Hello, Pawsome!

We have some meow-tastic news to share with you - Catizens is out in full release today! Players can now experience the final chapter of Tommath, Leandra, and their fluffy comrades-in-arms' dangerous journey to save the cat kingdom.

Your resources are limited, and the final stage will take a long time to get through. Do you have what it takes?

https://youtu.be/wdg7uhMGj5Y

The full version of the game contains the following features and additions:
[list]
[*] The final level of the game: The summit of Lava Mountain. The most challenging task there is to save the Cat Kingdom. Resources are limited, and the time is ticking. Can you handle such a difficult job?
[*] The final boss: A big, scary Dragon for your cute kitties to fight!
[*] Sandbox mode: Develop your feline settlement without the campaign story restrictions. Build a cute town for your cats in various environments. Forest, Swamp, Mountain, and mixed-terrain biomes will be available in this mode.
[*] More randomized events in both game modes.
[*] New decor items to decorate cat houses. Dragons are dragons, but coziness will not create itself!
[/list]
Grab the game at a discounted price for a limited time, play, share your impressions, and don't forget to leave reviews!

Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: The top of the Lava Mountain and the final boss, the Dragon
notes.content:
Hello, Pawsome! 

Long time no see, friends, but the work on the game continues.  We are putting the last touches on the final level of Catizens… which means the game is almost complete! The catizens have reached the top of the mountain and face their most dangerous challenge yet: saving the cat kingdom! 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZKq1vgY/2.gif[/img]

But it's not that simple – a lava-scorched wasteland and a giant dragon stand between the furry villagers and a peaceful life. With your help, they just might overcome these dangers!

 Here's what await the catizens in the new update: 
[list]
[*] Level 6: "The Summit." This land of ash, lava, and treacherous terrain is hated by all of the cats, but they must push through for the sake of the kingdom.
[*] A mission to save the Cat Kingdom. With limited resources and no new residents, protecting the village from the destructive lava flow will not be easy, but we hope you will succeed. 
[*] The new boss is a giant dragon. He patrols the neighborhood of the volcano and raids the cat's camp. Defeating him will require coordinated teamwork and leveled-up, mighty catizens.
[*] The conclusion of an epic cat's odyssey, but will they receive a happy ending?
[/list]
The update is currently being tested and bugs are being fixed, but it will be available to all players very soon!

Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: Catizens whelpling update is now available!
notes.content:
Hello Pawsome!

We've completed a brand new, feature-rich update for Catizens! We've mentioned some of the improvements in a previous post, but we want to tell you about them all over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/f8c6efe0a237e0a611aa37f155ac5d8ea85638ad.png[/img]

We've added: 
[list]
[*] New enemies – cute but dangerous whelplings that spit fireballs and can burn everything around them. Train your rangers to shoot down these adorable, but dangerous dragons before they attack your town.
[*] New protection for your settlement – Walls, watchtowers, and castle gates. The walls are a great defence against the rats and whelplings. And the watchtower can be used to shoot enemies at a distance (and keep the tower's guardian safe!) 
[*] New resource – Keep your eyes peeled for the magic crystals and don't miss them on the map.
[*] New armor and swords for knights – Your blacksmith can use magic crystals to forge these new armaments
[*] New decor – A mailbox in the shape of a fish, along with several fences. 
[/list]
We are still working on Chapter 5, a new interface, and additional decor elements for your kitty's houses. Hop into our purring community on [url=https://discord.gg/vhCsEnCks6]Discord[/url] and share your impressions of the game. We hope you'll love the new update. 

Regards, 
Catizens Team

notes.title: Crafting better weapons for your catizens
notes.content:
Hello Pawsome!

We're continuing our series of Catizens game guides. Last time, we covered [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/957660/announcements/detail/3690182497519563154]how to cook food[/url] for catizens, as well as how to find and grow basic ingredients. Today, we're going to tell you how to equip your Knights and Rangers with more advanced weapons.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_86152fea560f447eabdf6679af062b45~mv2.gif[/img]
   
All of the weapons in the game are crafted by cats with the "Blacksmith" trait. From the third level of the game, you can hire a smith at the Market in exchange for a few gold coins. Before then, you'll have to make due with the weapons your cats came with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/552f27b4e6a17ac1c6bcd5e4a19a9d0b447e9137.png[/img]

You can craft more advanced weapons for your Knights and Rangers to strengthen them against enemies: 
[list]
[*] Steel and golden swords;
[*] Recurve and golden bows;
[*] Metal shields;
[*] Knight's chest plate;
[*] Leather boots. 
[/list]
A first level blacksmith can only forge steel swords. To unlock other items, upgrade your smith cat's talents. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_4c675aff1d2a4aea90b792c2af81c608~mv2.gif [/img]

You will also need special resources to craft each of these items: 
[list]
[*] [b]Metal Ore[/b] – extracted from rocks and metal ore deposits.
[*] [b]Gold[/b] – can be found in mines, obtained from rocks, or as a trophy when defeating rats.
[*] [b]Leather and sinew[/b] – obtained when hunting wolves and bears.
[*] [b]Feathers[/b] – dropped by crows when attacking your crops.
[/list]
You can also buy these items at the market, but they'll cost you.

When you have enough resources, and the right talents from the Blacksmith are available, you can start the process of making weapons in the Crafting Menu. The blacksmith will venture to the forge and begin their work. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_a905502c3b9e4c1aaa0fb041c08e2a9c~mv2.gif[/img]

Tell us in the comments what other aspects of Catizens you'd like us to write about. And do not forget to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url], where you can quickly get answers to any questions about the game. 


Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: How to create delicious treats in Catizens
notes.content:
Hello Pawsome! 

We're excited to tell you how to create yummy treats in Catizens. All of the kitties love eating tasty food, and some prefer certain snacks over others. The little furballs might even ask you to create something special for them.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_afad10667e0b4468bb9da6682de7b24f~mv2.gif[/img]

In Catizens, you can treat cats to [b]meat[/b], [b]fish[/b], [b]catnip[/b], [b]pumpkin[/b], and [b]cabbage[/b] – these are all simple foods.

However, there are also complex ones that you can craft:
[list]
[*] [b]Soup[/b] – a delicious combination of pumpkin and cabbage.
[*] [b]Bread[/b] – with a deliciously crispy crust, of course.
[*] [b]Catffine[/b] – a refreshing drink brewed from catnip.
[*] [b]Milk[/b] – what cat can't resist a saucer of milk?
[*] [b]Cheese[/b] – it's also a treat for rats, which means it can be used to negotiate a truce.
[/list]

[h2]How to get simple tasty treats[/h2]

You can obtain [b]meat[/b] by slaying wild boars and other predators in the area.

Catizens with the Fisher trait can catch [b]fish[/b] in a nearby river. Just tell them where the fishing spot is and they'll cast their lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/900b895057fbe30f9bd147cd33121760ded7dbc9.png[/img] 

[b]Catnip[/b] grows around the settlements. You can also grow it in the fields if you fulfill a request from a cat with the Catnip Lover trait. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/8deb7a64839cb0698bbc8cbad5152512f06080c2.png[/img]

[b]Cabbage[/b] and [b]pumpkins[/b] are grown and harvested by farmer cats and do not require any special attention from you. The only thing you'll need to do is fend off annoying flocks of crows who want to eat your delicious crops, but building a scarecrow will keep them away.

[h2]How to prepare these complex delicacies[/h2]

It will take a lot of effort to create [b]milk[/b], [b]bread[/b], [b]cheese[/b], [b]soup[/b], or [b]Cattfin[/b]. You have to spend time developing your farmers and honing their talents.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_c88ea4022d1445af831b1b1d2efa5431~mv2.gif[/img]

[h3]Milk[/h3]

Build a Stable and buy a few cows, who will start producing [b]milk[/b] . You'll be able to build the Stables after unlocking the appropriate farmer cat talent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/2216003f161ecf0e16228cac44617ed2d8bb588b.png[/img]

Cows produce milk every 25 in-game hours. The farmer cat will milk the cow and take the milk to the warehouse – you do not need to take any additional steps to get it.

[h3]Soup and Cheese[/h3]

To make [b]soup [/b]or [b]cheese[/b], you need a cat with the “Basic Cooking” talent. You may build an Outdoor Kitchen as soon as a kitty with that talent appears in your settlement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/ec5a42ab77caf24ace4ab711b400990ef2df0ac6.png[/img]

The [b]soup[/b] is made from cabbage and pumpkin, and cheese is made from milk. You already know how to obtain these resources, so it'll be easy to satisfy the needs of your catizens.

[h3]Bread[/h3]

Catizens love [b]bread[/b], but you'll need flour, wheat, and a windmill to make it. The first step is to assign the "Wheat" and "Windmill" traits to a farmer kitty, then the Windmill will be available in the build menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/e7352bba7dfa090c4da68f3398a8742d068fa5a6.png[/img]
 
The farmers will plant, water, and then harvest the wheat as sheaves. The other catizens will then collect the sheaves and take them to the storehouse. Once there is wheat in the store, the flour-making process will automatically start.

To bake bread, you need to unlock a farmer's "Bread" talent. After that, the cats can use the stove at the Outdoor Kitchen.

[h3]Catffine[/h3]

And, finally, the last delicious thing that lifts the spirits of all kitties: [b]catffine[/b]. To create it, you need to unlock the farmer's "Tavern" talent and then build a tavern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/3b5e376c4e8631a9d3e130daf2a02e5b95c96d9f.png[/img]

[h2]Crafting Menu[/h2]

You'll need the Crafting Menu to begin the process of making soup, bread, cheese and catffine. Open the menu and select the desired number of dishes. After that, the cat farmer will go to the Outdoor Kitchen, or the Tavern, to prepare the goodies. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_43ae326c9a4c4a2987a3795a835caf56~mv2.gif [/img]

We hope you're excited about creating treats for the kitties of the cat kingdom.

Tell us in the comments what other aspects of Catizens you'd like us to write about. And do not forget to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url], where you can quickly get answers to any questions about the game. 

Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: New kitties, accessories, and customization options
notes.content:
Hello, pawsome!

It's been a while since you heard from the fluffy Catizens team. But we didn’t pause our work, in fact, we have been keeping our paws on the game. 

All this time we've been working on new cat accessories, new decor items, and legendary kitties that will join your community if certain conditions are met.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/a6c54e9024562a2f90014ecac5bfd461e6ebad30.png[/img]

Such catizens have special colors and equipment. Mind, if you give them a profession, they will lose their special outfits.

Some of them may look familiar to you. Can you guess what they refer to? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/ad128c532e864e5fde54d1d0df798c68aac55320.png[/img]

Fulfilling the requests of some catizens, you will be rewarded with accessories. For example, a Halo, a Night Cap, Sunglasses, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/443ea8395a83cb949e546c005b6e3ea770e88438.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/0bdfe7d7c359e803e2ef5e4931408e58718b2e8e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/5725264b961d00444f92f8cbadaaf6c1801c9384.png[/img]

There will be a new type of decoration in town – a small, cozy house, perfect for one cat. Single cats will be over the moon. We also updated the model of the wishing well, we hope you like it. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_3604880888814d528a86eb83a6552af8~mv2.gif[/img]

In addition, we added new options for customizing your cats at the beginning of the game:
[list]
[*] Ear shapes;
[*] New shade of fur;
[*] New cat base coat. The existing dark coat has been renamed to Medium and a new darker base coat has been added.
[*] New cat coat patterns: Abyssinian, Blotchy, Brows, Pants, Rex, Tortoise Shell, Tuxedo, Sphynx.
[*] New cat eyes: Bi Color, Half Color, Persian, Serval.
[*] New cat mouths: Fangs, Fangs 2, Pink, Big Nose.
[/list]

You will be able to place furniture and decorations inside the houses, decorate the roofs of cat houses, and improve the blacksmith's workshop.

Join the Catizens community on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url], and don't forget to tell your friends and fellow streamers about the game. 

Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: Your cute, amazing or unique idea for a cat can be in Catizens!
notes.content:
Hello, pawsome!

A Catizens player shared a funny screenshot of Meowtos on our official [url=https://discord.com/channels/911283255381229568/988472343770849360/1040627515863085198]Discord[/url], and our team thought it was a really cool idea! We are planning to introduce special catizens to the game, which may settle in your town if it becomes popular enough.

To celebrate. we're starting a contest to find the most fun and unusual idea for a special cat in Catizens. Would you like your cool kitty idea to become part of the game? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/2a785ef985ba3aadc0967d5a54660802245718af.png[/img] 

[b]If the answer is yes, you'll need to create:[/b]
[list]
[*] The name of the kitty.
[*] Describe his or her appearance, habits, and character traits.
[*] A favorite thing the catizen would love to receive as a gift. 
[/list]
It can be a popular meme cat, an homage to your favorite movie/game/book character or your own original kitty. Draw fan art, create a full biography, create a TikTok about them, make an animation – anything you want!

Our team will pick [b]3 winners[/b] and all of them will have their character added to the world of Catizens. There is no limit to the number of characters that any person can submit. You can enter as many as you want to!

[b]To enter the competition, leave your ideas under this post on Steam.[/b] Additionally, you can post a description of your character on Twitter, TikTok, or Instagram with the tag #CatizensNewCat 

We will accept all ideas until January 19!

Hope you have a cat-tastic holiday! 
Catizens Team

notes.title: Celebration comes with the Catmas update!
notes.content:
Hello, pawsome!

Catmas is coming and it's the most wonderful time of the year! Kitty cats love it because they get to play with all of the shiny things on top of the tree. To celebrate the festive season, we are releasing a holiday update for all of you cat-lovers to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/826acbccffb7c2ad91840243056da1e43220e604.png[/img]

Catmas Reveler will visit your settlement with gifts and holiday accessories. You'll have a lot of fun dressing up the Catmas tree and the catizens. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_61c3777b6c52439990bd5ef422b82cbc~mv2.gif [/img]

We've also made the Rat King a bit more difficult – he now has special attacks on the “Catverage” difficulty level. If your Knights are fast enough, you'll be able to use their “Stunning Slash” talent before the King finishes his special attack. After defeating the vicious foe, you will be rewarded with a unique accessory – a crown. Only cats are worthy of wearing crowns, don't you agree?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/11ee27f1394cfb98a6a1df1c5335cbf61976a53d.png[/img]

And here are some more gifts we have in store for you:
[list]
[*] The Rangers' arrows and bows now have their own model..
[*] We've added a progress bar for the forge. When the Blacksmith is busy forging, you will see how much time is left to complete the item.
[*] Cats with the “Brave” trait are not afraid of anything. 
[*] Added a mini-tutorial for crafting.
[/list]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_2e5369ddbec74b31bbf52e2595e17611~mv2.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a request from an energetic cat. Completing it will reward you with a treadmill. 
[*] Fixed the bug that made all of the catizens sad. When a catizen with the trait “Green Paw” asked to decorate the settlement with potted plants, it remained blocked until the execution of this request.  
[*] Edited the in-game interface and added tooltips to the buttons. It is now easier to understand and use.
[*] Fixed a bug where cats continue to sleep in their old beds after a change of residence.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/68e07eb94eebd38b033a4115807a23e8a8e14ecb.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added new models for wheat, fences, and raven-damaged crops. 
[*] Added new cat requests that the player with decor items.
[*] Added a new scratching fleas' animation.
[/list]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_56ec524ca84540a181f7ce924e8bc803~mv2.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Various hints now appear on the loading screen.
[*] When placing objects, camera rotation is disabled if camera rotation and object placement are tied to the same keys.
[/list]
We continue to work on adding decor elements for houses, accessories for catizens and improving the interface for players. Check out the game's development plans in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/957660/view/3345631762251309449]the roadmap[/url].

If you have any feedback or suggestions for Catizens, please let us know here or on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url]. We want to create the puuurfect game for players. 

Hope you have a cat-tastic holiday! 
Catizens Team

notes.title: Swamps, Rat King and boots - check out the new update!
notes.content:
Hello, pawsome!

We have some purr-tastic news for you today! A brand new update for Catizens has been released, which contains a host of new content and tweaks.

Update the game, dive back into the cat kingdom and tell us what you think.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_29af70d7e5074650812b38a1cc7a214c~mv2.gif[/img]

List of changes: 
[list]
[*] A new area – Level 4, the Swamps.
[*] A new profession – The Acolyte. Acolytes are magic users that can either be talented in healing or attacking. The most skilled Acolytes can even resurrect previously deceased Catizens! 
Please note: not all of the Acolyte's talents have been implemented yet. Specifically, the “Shackles” and “Deadly Plague”  talents will be added in a future update. Some of the acolyte's magic casting animations are placeholders, so sorry they look a bit underwhelming at the moment!
[*] A new quest for the Rat King –- If you have completed the peace negotiations with the rats in the previous levels, the Rat King will now be a neutral character and will talk to you. Note: you might have to visit the previous levels and create a fresh save in order for the game to register that you completed those quests.
[*] Craft Pumpkin Lanterns – The Rat King can teach you how to create Pumpkin Lanterns that you can use to decorate your settlement. In a future update, we will add an ability for lanterns to protect you from the undead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/6fdbe83306be5816682a1e5949173a3d7d16e831.png[/img]
[*] The Craft Magical Armor quest is not yet fully implemented – it currently ends when you create a golden sword or golden bow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/e08932d81267353ff5f68dcadb21246889359f7a.png[/img]
[*] New craftable accessory –  Leather Armor, Metal Shield, and Leather Boots.
[*] Tooltips for armor/accessories now show the stat improvements they provide.
[*]Ranger Talent Update: The "Tame Animal" and "Make Camp" talents are now implemented.
[*]Placing roads and bridges will no longer also rotate the camera.
[*]New catizen status info available. You can now toggle between viewing everyone's traits, vs Stats, vs Buffs/Status when you have the citizens list expanded.
[/list]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_09f6a50de45d4c07ae197b8addd324a2~mv2.gif[/img]

This is all part of Update 1, as laid-out in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/957660/view/3345631762251309449]roadmap[/url]. We're hard at work on future updates and can't wait to show you more!

Help spread the word about Catizens and join our [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url], where you can leave feedback about the game, report bugs, chat to other players, and relax!

Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: New patch released and more content on the way!
notes.content:
Hello, pawsome! 

We received so much fantastic feedback about Catizens that we needed to get a giant new table for all of the notes! The Catizens community is fantastic and responsive when it comes to helping us with the game.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_59853cb96a95481fb4546d0744abee94~mv2.gif[/img]

Rest assured, we've gone through all of the comments, suggestions, and bugs. This update contains bug fixes and improvements to the base game, as well as some new content.

[h3][b]Important: You will need to create a new save file to enjoy some of the bug fixes as the existing saves for the sandbox mode remain broken. Sorry about that![/b][/h3]

What's new:
[list]
[*] Moved camera rotation control to the left mouse button in order to avoid conflicts when players issued instructions to catizens via the same button. This sometimes led to player issued commands being canceled when the player unintentionally rotated the camera.
[*] Creating the multi-selection box now allocated to shift + left click to drag.
[*] Fog of war will no longer return to full strength at night.
[*] Fog of war is a bit lighter and easier to see through for explored areas.
[*] Goldmines in all sandbox modes are now accessible.
[*] You can now change the name of all new catizens. Select the character, move the mouse over their name on the bottom left, and an edit pencil will pop up.
[*] Removed green text in tooltips – they are normal text colors now.
[*] Implemented ranger talent: Marksmanship and Rain of Arrows
[*] A large rat boss will appear in the sandbox mode.
[*] Added an Architect talent to move a building to a new location without having to rebuild. Select an architect (that has learned the ability), click on the ability, and select a building to move (left or right click on a building). That will open the build menu to let you place it in a new location. This ability has a 48-hour cooldown. Expectedly, this will disrupt the lives of anyone currently in and around the building.
[/list]
[b]Even more content in the works![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/557aeeb15da3278fcdd97691056b6e4ba6ff4e62.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/62bbcb7b1904bf952b1f6db1f90eb934bcad7bd8.png[/img]

Our team is busy working on Level 4, but we are also not forgetting about other cool stuff requested by players. For example, we have started designing more hats and accessories for catizens. Who doesn't love seeing adorable balls of fluff in cute gear?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/ebaeb4ee751d9f43998c305cc7055ceb5a46ee70.jpg[/img]

We are also developing new weapon concepts for the catizens and their enemies. And we are working on the talent tree for the new Acolyte profession, to be released with Level 4. You can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/957660/announcements/detail/3345631762251309450]read more about the development plans in the roadmap[/url]. 

Enjoy the cozy feline life, join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url] and help spread the word about Catizens!

Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: Catizens is out right meow!😻
notes.content:
Your pawsomeness!

It's time to party and eat some fish! Why? Because Catizens is now available in Early Access! To celebrate, we've created a video to show you some of the amazing things you can do in Catizens 🐱 
[previewyoutube=x1rVhh-TAaY;full][/previewyoutube]
During the initial Early Access release, you'll have the opportunity to play through three levels of the story campaign and explore the sandbox mode. There are six cat-tastic professions to try, different houses to build and decorate, and so much more! Can you build the purr-fect settlement?

And that's not all. We've planned a range of new features, creatures, and tweaks to come in future updates. You can read all about them in the full roadmap for Catizens:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/9b45227420796caf4dda53ebcbeff8bb098e6699.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Early Access Release[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The first three levels of the single-player campaign, each with its own challenges and covering several terrain types: grass, rivers, plateaus. 2-4 hours of gameplay.
[*] A sandbox mode with randomized levels and events.
[*] 6 professions available for catizens, with upgrades up to Level 10.
[*] 43 unique cat traits and quirks to play with and (try to) manage. 
[*] 12 buildings, each with its own distinct function available.
[*] Town decor items.
[*] Wearable vanity items for catizens.
[/list]
[h3][b]Update 1[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 4 added with a new terrain type (a swamp!).
[*] A new profession - Acolyte, allowing you to heal catizens and provide buffs.
[*] New boss rat enemy.
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/9b025abe1d997307275763e7cf5c2a58bd30d58a.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Update 2[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New wearable vanity items.
[*] New rooftop decorations.
[*] UI improvements and reskin.
[*] Full implementation of talent trees for existing professions (max level).
[*] New enemy type - alligator.
[*] Improvements suggested by players.
[/list]
[h3][b]Update 3[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 5 (volcanic climb).
[*] More decorations of various types added.
[*] New cat requests to earn decorations.
[*] New vanity items added.
[*] Improvements suggested by players.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/0f138924c82149455f492d06108b80c376adff53.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Update 4[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] More maps for the sandbox mode.
[*] More random events to trigger in both game modes.
[*] Quality of life improvements.
[/list]
[h3][b]Update 5[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 6 (the volcano top) and the story finale.
[*] New boss added - the dragon🙀
[/list]
We want to know what you think of Catizens. Please leave your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/957660/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or on our community [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url]. We wish you an un-fur-gettable game! 
 
Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: Catizen. Katzbürger!🙀🍔 พลเมืองชาวเหมียว!!🤯
notes.content:
Your pawsome! 

We know that cats are loved all over the world, but do you know what they're called in different languages? There's cat, der Kater, 猫, chat, แมว- and so many more! Why are we telling you this? Because Catizens will launch in six different languages on August 17!

In fact, the name Catizens is a play on words: it's "cat" + "citizens." So, we had to wrap our heads around how to translate such a unique proper noun into various languages, while still keeping it cozy and cuddly. 

And this is what we got: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/182886679cf40ef83d26f7d218b15d51700cca36.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/9ab75b45a9851da5af24d6993392aaea06404cff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/5d6e56fac2656c73711f76e3bed9fe38c5a5f9fc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/8532858cc5660b57bb78215f8070dfe400954caa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/0c4e5c14a5a4feb5ad18123fe8a643dfd54a70d2.png[/img]

From August 17, Catizens will be available in 6 languages: 
[list]
[*] English;    
[*] Russian;    
[*] Simplified Chinese;
[*] French;
[*] German;
[*] Thai.
[/list]
How would “catizen” sound in your language? Share your ideas in the comments.

We can't wait for you to meet all of the adorable kitties. Add the game to your Steam Wishlist and join our cozy community on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url].

Regards,
Catizens Team

notes.title: Build a Tavern to delight your kitties
notes.content:
Hello, pawsome!

We love telling you about all of the new buildings and features in Catizens! Today, we'd like you to pull up a chair, grab a flagon of your favourite drink and prepare to learn about the wonderful Tavern.

Some Catizens like sitting or sleeping in high spots – call it a necessity or just the need to look down upon others. That's why the Tavern’s design is based on the idea of a cat tree - plenty of cozy sleeping spots at just the right height!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/6f9e0b260ce57acdd57390a24096b5ad447e364d.png[/img]

As a tasty bonus - a farmer cat can cook delicious treats in the Tavern's kitchen, such as:
[list]
[*]Catffine, a catnip-rich drink that will give kitties a serious boost of energy.
[*]A wheat-based brew that will improve any cat's mood.
[/list]
Did we mention that the Tavern is also a gorgeous piece of architecture that will add to the beauty of your settlement? We can't wait for you to build it!

Respectfully,
Catizens Team

notes.title: Bath house hotfix is live!
notes.content:
Hello pawsome!

Only two days have passed since the start of the festival, and we've already received so much useful feedback, as well as kind and purring words of encouragement from players. Bad Optics Games and HeroCraft PC are grateful to everyone that has eagerly joined us in the world of Catizens. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38790098/8bf4c54ff93a1502ca3b17d5f6d88fe470ffdb27.jpg[/img]

Thanks to your feedback, we've prepared a patch that fixes a nasty bug that led to your catizens getting stuck inside a bath house. Who would have thought that washing cats would be such a huge problem even in-game, right? :P

Re-download the demo to fix the error. And please continue posting in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/957660] Community Hub[/url] and writing in with questions, suggestions and cool stories about your catizens - everyone is welcome!

Respectfully,
The Catizens Team
